config.label: CIE AS & A Level Psychology
config.author: Smartious Homeschool
config.description: The complete Smartious course notes for Cambridge International AS & A Level Psychology (9990) in a single volume. 148 lessons covering the AS core studies in the biological, cognitive, learning and social approaches, AS and A Level research methods and issues and debates, all four A Level options (Clinical, Consumer, Health and Organisational Psychology), and a closing section on exam technique with practice papers. Organised lesson by lesson to follow the syllabus.
